day.text: I visited Blair and that's where my +1 came from, so Blair's Turkey claim checks out with me. Casey, who did you visit? Whoever Casey visited, I'd like to know if they gained anything.

day.note: I'm the Owl and learned a Mouser visited Blair, which makes a Meowfia cat real. Sharing this helps the Farm team.

day.text: I'm the Hawk. I visited Casey and got nothing, so Casey isn't Meowfia by my read. Casey's Owl claim is plausible, but Alex's Eagle claim says Casey was visited, which would block the Owl egg. Someone is lying about that, so Alex and Casey, check each other.
day.note: I'm the Hawk, visited Casey, and got no egg, so Casey is not Meowfia (if I wasn't hugged). Sharing this helps Farm.

day.text: Casey, you're saying nobody visited you, but Alex says they visited you. Both can't be true. Alex, who hugged you? Your nest didn't move, so I'm curious what you learned.

Casey's claim is accurate about the Mouser visit, but confirming it would expose me. I'll stay quiet this beat and watch how Alex and Casey's claims resolve.

day.text: Casey, I visited you, so you weren't unvisited. The Owl +1 can't be right. My Eagle hug doesn't change that I was there. Blair, if Drew visited you as Turkey you should have gained an egg, so either Drew or you is off.
day.note: I visited Casey, so Casey had at least one visitor, which means Casey's Owl claim (+1 only if no one else visited) doesn't add up. Casey is my top suspect. Blair's Turkey +0 also conflicts with Drew's claimed visit.

Alex and Casey are already sorting out the contradiction, and speaking more could draw attention to me. I'll stay quiet this beat.

day.note: Casey says nobody visited them, but I visited Casey as Hawk. That makes Casey's Owl +1 false, so Casey is likely Meowfia. Push the table toward Casey.

Alex.confusing: The hug mechanics were hard to read, since a hug on a visitor can come from the visited player's Floofer role, and the dawn reports didn't make clear which visit caused it. The Owl and Eagle egg counts also left me unsure which claims were true.
Alex.fun: Round 3 was the most fun: I visited Drew, got hugged, and worked out from the hug pattern that Drew was the Floofer and Meowfia. My vote and throw then helped Farm win.
Alex.change: Make the dawn reports clearer about who hugged whom, so players can check claims against the hugs instead of guessing.
Alex.regret: In round 1 I voted for Casey, who was Farm, and never pressed Drew, who was Meowfia and whose visit story I doubted. I would have pushed the vote onto Drew and questioned his Blair visit sooner.

Blair.confusing: The Mouser and Floofer visit rules were hard to track, since a hug only shows up as a dawn report and the day claims often conflicted. Hugs and the Owl and Eagle counts made it hard to tell who was lying.

Finley.confusing: The hug mechanics were the hardest to track: a Floofer hugs its visitors, but several players claimed hugs from different visitors, so the hug sources were hard to pin down.
